recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up glamour portrait of a woman with voluminous, dark, curly hair, featuring high-contrast lighting that emphasizes facial structure and deep red lips. The composition is framed by a dark, textured background and topped with a dual-style typographic header combining a rigid sans-serif and a fluid, metallic script.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting against dark, wild hair
Juxtaposition of sharp, geometric text with organic, flowing script
Warm skin tones against a cool, dark, atmospheric background
Verticality of the script ascenders integrated into the hair texture
coreInvariants: Deep burgundy or red lip color
Voluminous, textured dark hair filling the upper corners
Soft-focus skin texture with sharp eye definition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, head and shoulders, filling 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the high-contrast red lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the lips, then upward to the metallic typography in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; primarily the dark areas within the hair and the background shadows.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the hair and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, pale skin tones with golden highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep crimson/burgundy for the lips and silver/chrome for the text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, blacks, and metallic silver

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of an ultra-wide, thin sans-serif and a high-contrast formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Top line: extremely wide tracking, thin strokes, all-caps.
Bottom line: vertical, elongated script with sharp, needle-like ascenders and descenders.
Metallic chrome gradient effect on all letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated 'M' and 'y' strokes that extend vertically to intersect the top line.

typesetting.tracking: Wide for sans, tight for script

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the dark background of the hair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, horizontal geometry and fluid, vertical calligraphy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule line intersecting the top text
Small star-like glints on metallic surfaces

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, thin, serif-influenced sans-serif top line.
Provides the base for the high-contrast, elegant script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast 80s glamour portrait of a woman with voluminous dark curly hair, pale skin, and deep red lips. Use dramatic side-lighting and a dark, moody background. The hair should fill the top corners of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line typographic lockup in the top left. The top line should be a wide-tracked, thin sans-serif. The bottom line should be a large, vertically elongated metallic script that overlaps the hair. Apply a chrome bevel effect to all text.

verificationChecks: Is the hair sufficiently voluminous and dark?
Do the lips have a deep burgundy matte finish?
Is the text metallic and beveled?
Does the script have long, sharp vertical strokes?

adjustableVariables: Vertical length of the script flourishes
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark hair.
Check that the skin tones don't look overly orange or saturated.
Verify the metallic glints are subtle and not distracting.
Confirm the composition feels top-heavy due to the hair and text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion 80s portrait with a dual-style metallic typographic header placed in the upper-left quadrant.
